caption: The drawing depicts a hexagonal box with a decorative floral pattern. The box is primarily light beige in color with pink, green, and red accents. Each visible side and the top of the box features a central motif of a red basket holding an arrangement of flowers with pink, red, and green hues. The panels also contain ornate, looping designs in soft gray and beige tones. The edges and corners of the box are bordered with a reddish-pink trim. The whole box rests on a plain, unadorned background, and there is a faint artist's signature in the bottom right corner. The detailed patterns and the arrangement of the flowers on each side are consistent, with the background behind the flowers filled with intricate, pale scrollwork and lace-like designs.
title: Bandbox
